fix: In /home/claude/juice/src/fruit/species.js, the round-6 fix asked for two things and the build delivered (a) - the blobFade guard now suppresses sub-pixel flesh detail - but not (b), the resolved mesh that was supposed to REPLACE it. Deleting the noise without adding the mesh is why flesh_mean_rgb moved 8% of its gap and every speck-shape statistic moved zero. Build the mesh, and build it as a CELL FIELD, not a spoke fan: a jittered Worley/Voronoi over the face in cut-plane UV at a cell pitch of 4-6 px at our review size (the plate's scale-matched speck_median_area is 4 px, its p95/median is 8.55, i.e. a tight mid-sized population, which is what a cell field produces and what an octave of fbm cannot), anisotropically stretched ~3:1 along the radial direction so the cells read as bundles; lift albedo HARD on the cell walls - the plate's flesh mean is 189.7 with GR 0.353 while its crimson ground must be far darker and far more saturated than that, so the wall must go pale-pink and high-R, not white, or GR will rise instead of falling - and pull the cell interiors toward the plate's saturated crimson. Gate the whole field through blobFade at the CELL radius, not at the noise-octave radius, so that at portrait scale the cells coarsen rather than vanish. Then fix the vignette: the 0.40-0.80 annulus of the face is at 119.7 against the plate's 195.5 while the core is already at 165 against 172, so whatever falloff term darkens the face toward its rim needs to be flattened - the plate's face gets brighter outward, ours must stop getting darker. VERIFY WITH THE FROZEN PROBE AND AGAINST THE SCALE-MATCHED COLUMN, NOT THE r6 THRESHOLDS, WHICH WERE READ OFF THE PLATE AT 7.7x OUR PIXEL DENSITY AND ARE WRONG. Reproduce the control first so we agree on the target: resample reference/plate-01.png by 1/2.78 (Lanczos) and run `python3 tools/probes.py foam <that> win=115:203:196:290` - it must give mask_px 5518. Then `python3 tools/probes.py foam shots/r8/05-cut+500ms.png` (default win, quote mask_px, it must stay near 5450) must satisfy, in ONE frame: flesh_mean_rgb R >= 165 (matched plate 189.7, we are at 131.0), flesh_GR <= 0.39 (matched plate 0.3530, we are at 0.4409), speck_median_area >= 4 (matched plate 4.0, we are at 2.0), speck_pct_single_px <= 28 (matched plate 25.8, we are at 36.4), speck_cov_pct 23-27 (matched plate 26.01, we are at 18.97 - this must go UP, the r6 verdict's 17-21 band was a scale artefact), speck_area_p95_over_median <= 10 (matched plate 8.55, we are at 16.4), and pct_R_ge_255 <= 2.0 (matched plate 0.127, we are at 4.109) so none of the brightness is bought with clipping. Also re-run at scale=0.40: the core must not fall below 165 and its speck_pct_single_px must come DOWN from 45.8. And run the same default-window probe on shots/r8-iphone/05-cut+500ms.png (win=255:345:85:175): flesh R must clear 130 and pct_lum_le_25 must drop under 12, or the mesh has faded out at portrait scale and the shipping build has not been fixed.
